title: NYC Daily Digest
text:
Good morning, Matthew ☕
Monday, September 14, 2026

🌤️ Weather — NYC
Clouds clear to afternoon sun, mild in the mid-70s, humidity dropping. A crisp fall chill tonight down to the 50s. Light layers today — you'll want a jacket for the walk home.

🗞️ Headlines
• Gas prices climbing — national average up to ~$4.31/gal, +16¢ in a week.
• Trump downplays AI risks as tech CEOs warn the tech is moving too fast.
• US Air Force crew member recounts his ejection and rescue after being shot down over Iran in April.
• Hidden-camera report shows lobbyists courting a would-be client dangling a presidential pardon.

🚇 Getting around
Weekend track work (Sept 11–14) is wrapping up — weekday service should be back to normal for the Monday commute. Quick check the app if you're riding early: LIRR had Atlantic–Jamaica outages and there were changes on several lines over the weekend.

🎉 NYC today
Charli xcx headlines Barclays Center tonight (7:30PM). Lower-key: The Moth StorySLAM at The Bell House (8PM) and the NYBG fall pumpkin display is up in the Bronx.

💡 Nugget
Today's the crisp-air pivot — first real "sweater weather" night of the season. Great evening for a walk before the short days set in.
